# Vendure

> Vendure is the open-source commerce platform built for B2B complexity, and every channel beyond it. An extensible, self-hostable core (GPLv3), with a commercial Vendure Platform that adds out-of-the-box B2B capabilities (organization hierarchies, customer-specific and volume pricing, approval workflows), plus managed Vendure Cloud.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vendure.io/index.md): Open-source commerce platform for complex B2B, and every channel beyond it.
- [Become a Partner](https://vendure.io/become-a-partner.md): The Vendure Partner Program is open to agencies and system integrators. Earn lead referrals, commission, co-marketing and certification by building on Vendure.
- [Brand](https://vendure.io/brand.md): Official Vendure brand guidelines. Download logos, access our color palette, and explore our typography. Everything you need to represent Vendure correctly.
- [Careers](https://vendure.io/careers.md): Join the small, senior team building Vendure, the open-source commerce platform brands like IBM run in production. Real ownership, bias to ship.
- [Contact](https://vendure.io/contact.md): Talk to the Vendure team about Platform, Cloud, support services, or finding an implementation partner. We reply within 24 business hours.
- [Demo](https://vendure.io/demo.md): Try Vendure free in our public online demo, preloaded with sample data, so you can explore the admin dashboard and storefront before you install or self-host.
- [Pricing](https://vendure.io/pricing.md): Build with Vendure Core (OSS) or Vendure Platform (enterprise). Run it yourself or on Vendure Cloud: the managed runtime for any Vendure project.
- [Vendure Professional Services](https://vendure.io/professional-services.md): Vendure Professional Services: PoC, specialist build support, migration, training, and support retainers from the Vendure engineering team. Evaluate to run.
- [Complex B2B, running on one platform](https://vendure.io/solutions/b2b-commerce.md): Vendure is the B2B ecommerce platform for company accounts, approvals, quote negotiation, contract pricing, and ERP-driven catalogues. Production-ready.
- [The open-source enterprise ecommerce platform](https://vendure.io/solutions/open-source-for-enterprise.md): An enterprise ecommerce platform on an open-source core: B2B depth, multi-channel, governance, and 4-year LTS, with supply-chain integrity you can verify.
- [Self-hosted Vendure: own your commerce infrastructure](https://vendure.io/solutions/self-hosted-commerce.md): Run Vendure on your own infrastructure with a commercial license, enterprise plugins, and vendor support. Move to Vendure Cloud later, without a re-platform.
- [B2B procurement workflows](https://vendure.io/product/b2b-workflows.md): Account hierarchies, approvals, quotes, quick order, reorder, shopping lists. B2B procurement workflows, built into Vendure.
- [Catalogue and pricing: pricing logic you control](https://vendure.io/product/catalogue-pricing.md): Extensible B2B catalog across every channel and currency, with pricing logic in code: quantity breaks, contract prices, promotions, and packaging units.
- [Vendure Cloud: managed runtime for Vendure projects](https://vendure.io/product/cloud.md): Vendure Cloud is the managed runtime for any Vendure project: deploys, environments, migrations, scaling, and infra run by the team that builds Vendure.
- [Headless commerce platform, built as one](https://vendure.io/product/commerce-backend.md): Vendure is the open-source headless commerce platform: one unified backend, Admin Dashboard, and B2B foundations. Enterprise-ready, extensible at the core.
- [Vendure Core: open-source commerce framework](https://vendure.io/product/core.md): Vendure Core is the open-source ecommerce framework you can read, extend, and self-host. Built on TypeScript and NestJS for teams that need control.
- [Developer experience: the Node.js ecommerce platform teams want to work on](https://vendure.io/product/developer-experience.md): Vendure's developer experience: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, a CLI, real testing tools, and a codebase your team and their AI tools can ship on.
- [Extensibility & APIs: plugins, custom data, and GraphQL extensions](https://vendure.io/product/extensibility-apis.md): One extension model across Vendure, self-hosted or on Cloud: plugins, strategies, custom fields, and GraphQL extensions in TypeScript. No forking required.
- [Governance and compliance](https://vendure.io/product/governance-compliance.md): SSO, audit logging, and row-level access control, built into Vendure on the same platform that runs your catalogue and orders.
- [Vendure: the open-source commerce platform](https://vendure.io/product.md): One coherent backend for catalog, pricing, orders, and B2B workflows. Ship faster without fighting the platform.
- [Omnichannel commerce: one backend behind every channel](https://vendure.io/product/multi-channel-commerce.md): Omnichannel commerce on one Vendure backend: run an omnichannel ecommerce platform across web, mobile, marketplaces, and in-store from one catalogue, inventory, and customer record.
- [Operations: durable workflows and integrations](https://vendure.io/product/operations-automation.md): Durable workflows and a typed integration layer, built into Vendure. The operational backbone of your commerce, extensible to any channel.
- [Payments: one model, any provider behind it](https://vendure.io/product/payments.md): Vendure's payment layer: one handler interface for any provider, single- and two-step capture, refunds, and store credit as a native payment method.
- [One unified commerce platform for B2B, DTC, and every channel](https://vendure.io/product/platform.md): Vendure is a unified commerce platform: one backend for complex B2B, DTC, and every channel, with enterprise-grade plugins on an open-source core.
- [Enterprise features included in Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins.md): SSO, B2B pricing, approvals, audit, advanced search, and more enterprise plugins, bundled in Vendure Platform under one license and one support contract.
- [Search and discovery: one engine, every surface](https://vendure.io/product/search-discovery.md): Production-grade search built into Vendure. Storefront search, admin Cmd+K, geo-search, analytics. One engine, every surface.
- [Enterprise B2B storefront, production-ready from day one](https://vendure.io/product/storefront.md): A production-ready B2B storefront you own end-to-end. Company accounts, quote-to-order, approvals, and quick-order, built on Next.js.
- [Legal Notice](https://vendure.io/company/legal-notice.md): Legal notice and company information for Vendure, including registered company details and contact information as required by law.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vendure.io/company/privacy-policy.md): How Vendure collects, uses, and protects your personal data across vendure.io and our services. Read our full privacy policy.
- [Advanced search on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/advanced-search.md): Production-grade storefront search. Faceted, multi-language, geo-aware, analytics-ready. Self-hostable open-source engine. No third-party vendor.
- [Approval workflows on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/approval-workflows.md): Multi-level approval chains, configurable conditions, timeouts, and escalations. Generic engine for orders, quotes, and custom entities on Vendure Platform.
- [Audit logging on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/audit-logging.md): Entity changes, login events, optional read-access tracking. Configurable retention, scheduled exports, dashboard filter. Audit evidence built into Vendure.
- [B2B pricing: rule-based pricing without rule-grammar limits](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/b2b-pricing.md): Quantity breaks, customer-group pricing, customer-specific price lists, multi-currency, scheduled activation, bulk CSV import. B2B pricing on Vendure Platform.
- [Company accounts on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/company-accounts.md): Companies, business units, role-scoped users, shared addresses, payment methods. The B2B account foundation, native to Vendure Platform.
- [Content versioning on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/content-versioning.md): Snapshot history for products and editorial content on Vendure. Diff any two versions, restore one click, draft mode for staging. Native, not a CMS bolt-on.
- [Enterprise SSO on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/enterprise-sso.md): SAML 2.0 and OIDC for Vendure admin login. Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, Auth0, Keycloak. Auto-provision admins, map IdP roles. Included in Platform.
- [Quote management on Vendure Platform](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/quote-management.md): Full quote lifecycle, multi-version pricing, internal and external comments, quote templates, durable workflow. Quote-to-order on Vendure Platform.
- [Store credit and gift cards: native payment method, one ledger](https://vendure.io/product/plugins/store-credit-and-gift-cards.md): Native store credit and gift cards as a payment method. Admin-issued credit, customer-purchased gift cards, custom templates, tax-aware. On Vendure Platform.

- [Announcing Vendure v1.9](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v1-9.md): Vendure v1.9 (codename Kitzbühel) adds custom order and customer history entries, a new ActiveOrderStrategy for advanced B2B workflows, and a login refresh.
- [New Versioning Strategy and Roadmap](https://vendure.io/blog/new-versioning-strategy-and-roadmap.md): Read more about the upcoming release and the changes to our versioning strategy. We also provide a public roadmap from now on.

- [Multi-tenant Commerce with Vendure](https://vendure.io/blog/multi-tenant-commerce-with-vendure.md): Run multiple shops or a marketplace from one Vendure instance using Channels. Set up tenants, roles, and storefronts from the admin, no code required.
- [Lightning Fast Headless Commerce with Vendure and Remix](https://vendure.io/blog/lightning-fast-headless-commerce-with-vendure-and-remix.md): Why Remix suits headless commerce with Vendure: server rendering by default, minimal browser JavaScript, edge hosting on Cloudflare, plain fetch over GraphQL.
- [Announcing Vendure v1.6](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v1-6.md): Vendure v1.6 of the open-source headless commerce framework focuses on two areas: performance and collections. A deep dive into the improvements in both.
- [Announcing Vendure v1.5](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v1-5.md): Vendure v1.5 marks a point of high stability and maturity, adding security features, coupon code editing and Stripe support, plus a look ahead to Vendure 2.0.
- [Vendure & Vue Storefront Integration v1.0](https://vendure.io/blog/vendure-vue-storefront-integration-v1-0.md): Vue Storefront, the fastest-growing open-source storefront solution for headless commerce, has just released v1.0 of its official Vendure integration.
- [Announcing Vendure v1.4](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v1-4.md): Vendure v1.4 brings major Admin UI improvements, including custom field controls, tabbed fields and locale support, plus the official payments plugin.
- [Serverless e-commerce: Vendure on Google Cloud Run](https://vendure.io/blog/serverless-e-commerce-vendure-on-google-cloud-run.md): A step-by-step guide to deploying Vendure on Google Cloud Run, with Cloud SQL for the database, Cloud Storage for assets, and Cloud Tasks for the worker.

A walkthrough of the integration.

- [Vendure v0.13.0: The Customer is Always Right](https://vendure.io/blog/vendure-v0-13-0-the-customer-is-always-right.md): Vendure v0.13.0 centres on customer management, adding customer groups for business logic and segmentation, plus a full customer history timeline for admins.
- [Announcing Vendure v0.12.0](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v0-12-0.md): Vendure v0.12.0 adds production-deployment features: a health check endpoint, AWS S3 asset storage, and lifecycle methods for configurable strategies.
- [Announcing Vendure v0.11.0](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v0-11-0.md): Vendure v0.11.0 introduces a rewritten job queue with multiple queues, concurrency, retries, and configurable storage, plus a NestJS framework upgrade to v7.
- [Announcing Vendure v0.10.0](https://vendure.io/blog/announcing-vendure-v0-10-0.md): Vendure v0.10.0 brings major Admin UI improvements: an upgrade to Angular 9 and Ivy, re-architected UI packages, and the new ui-devkit for UI extensions.
